# Packages whose tests run on the windows-latest job (.github/workflows/windows.yml).
# One package per line; '#' starts a comment. No wildcards ("./...").
# NEVER ./pkg/hub or a ./pkg/hub/... package: the unsharded pkg/hub test
# compile needs about 12 GiB (the job fails if such a line appears).
# A package left off for a Windows-environment reason gets a one-line reason
# here; nothing is skipped.
./pkg/util/privatefs
./pkg/util/pathcanon
./pkg/util/filelock
./pkg/tunnelclient
./pkg/credentials
./pkg/apiclient
# ./pkg/config: anchored to its Windows private-file tests (the full suite
# is POSIX-bound).
./pkg/config -run=^(TestWindowsHubProjectsDir_AliasFormsAreUnder|TestWindowsHubProjectsDir_UnresolvableIsUnder|TestWindowsHubProjectsDir_UnknownHomeIsUnder|TestWindowsHubWorkspace_AliasFormsSkipProjectLayer|TestWindowsHubWorkspace_UnresolvableProjectsDirSkipsProjectLayer|TestWindowsAtomicWrite_PrivateReplacesTooOpenInheritInherits|TestWindowsAtomicWrite_PrivateReplacesSymlinkNotTarget|TestWindowsAtomicWrite_InheritKeepsOwnerOnlyTarget|TestWindowsAtomicWrite_InheritDecisionDoesNotFollowLink|TestWindowsPersistHubID_GlobalDirAndFilePrivate|TestWindowsSettingsLock_RefusesJunctionLockFile|TestWindowsUpdateCLIContext_Private|TestWindowsIntegrationConfig_Private|TestWindowsCurrentUserOwns|TestWindowsMigrateLegacyGlobalLayout_SkipsForeignOwnedEntry|TestWindowsMkdirLikeLegacyRoot_FollowsSourceACL|TestWindowsWriteConflictBackup_Private|TestWindowsCopySettingsBackup_FollowsSourceACL|TestWindowsCopySettingsBackup_DecisionFromReadHandle|TestWindowsProtectionForCheck_FailsClosed|TestWriteConflictBackup_PartialFileRemovedOnFailure)$
# ./pkg/brokercredentials: the Windows-reachable read (the write path and
# multistore are gated).
./pkg/brokercredentials -run=^(TestWindowsBrokerCredentials_RefusesUsersReadableFile|TestWindowsBrokerCredentials_RefusesSymlink|TestWindowsBrokerCredentials_MissingIsNotFound|TestStore_Load|TestStore_LoadNotFound|TestStore_LoadValidation)$
# ./pkg/agent: the GitHub resolution cache and host state only (the rest is
# gated agent provisioning).
./pkg/agent -run=^(TestWindowsResolutionCache_NewDirAndFilePrivate|TestWindowsResolutionCache_RepairsOwnedTooOpenFile|TestWindowsResolutionCache_ForeignOwnedFileWarnedNotRepaired|TestWindowsResolutionCache_TooOpenDirWarnedNotRepaired|TestWindowsHostState_Unsupported)$
./pkg/hubprofile
# ./cmd: anchored to the Windows-relevant tests (the full suite is
# POSIX-bound). Never the attachment-writing
# message tests.
./cmd -run=^(TestSSHWrite_NewFilePrivate|TestSSHWrite_FollowsUserSymlinkAndRepairsOpenTarget|TestSSHWrite_RefusesForeignWritableParent|TestSSHWrite_RefusesForeignOwnedTarget|TestSSHWrite_RefusesHardLinkedTarget|TestSSHKnownHostsTempFilePrivate|TestSSHShellQuoteForCmd|TestSSHCmdQuote_RefusesShellSpecialChars|TestSSHEndpointURL_RefusesShellSpecialChars|TestSSHWindowsForm_RefusesEndpointShellSpecialChars|TestSSHWindowsForm_RefusesExePathShellSpecialChars|TestRenderSSHHostBlock_WindowsFormEndpointWithPath|TestRenderSSHHostBlock_WindowsFormIPv6Endpoint|TestVSCode_ValidatesArgumentsForCmdLauncher|TestCheckVSCodeBatchArgs|TestPrepareSSH_RefusalMakesNoTempDir|TestVSCodeFiles_PrivateOnWindows|TestLockVSCodeDir_TimesOut|TestLockVSCodeDir_WaitsForRelease|TestLockVSCodeDir_DefaultWait|TestHubTestIdentityOut_DescribesACL|TestResolveBrokerJoinToken_WarnsOnForeignACE|TestWindowsGate_RefusesServerAndBroker|TestWindowsGate_DropsFlagValidationOnGatedCommands|TestWindowsGate_RefusesBeforeProjectResolution|TestWindowsGate_HidesOnlyGatedCommands|TestWindowsGate_AllowlistEntriesExist|TestWindowsGate_NoopOnUnix|TestWindowsGate_AllowsUseOnlyUnderProject|TestWindowsUse_SelectWritesPrivateContext|TestSSHAndVSCodeFollowLinksOutsideHome|TestSSHDirCallers_LinkTargetFailingRuleIRefused|TestSSHWrite_LinkToForeignOwnedTargetRefused|TestEnsureSSHDir_RefusesInvalidComponents|TestEnsureSSHDir_ShortNameStaysInside|TestSSHVSCodeWriteLeaves_RefuseHardLinks|TestEnsureSSHDirOnlyUsesTheHandleWalk|TestSSHPrepare_SpaceInTempWindows|TestSSHKnownHostsOptionValue|TestSSHDirRelsMatchPaths|TestSSHWrite_WarnsOnMutableLinkTargetParent|TestWriteSSHHubPlan_HardLinkedConfigWithIncludeLineUntouched|TestUpdateVSCodeFiles_HardLinkedSettingsUnchangedUntouched)$
